mapper.select: SELECT a.AUTHORITY_ID, a.AUTHORITY_NAME, a.CREATE_DT, a.UPDATE_DT, a.CREATE_ID, a.UPDATE_ID, a.DEL_YN, a.IS_SYSTEM FROM T3000_AUTHORITY a JOIN T3000_AUTHORITY_ACCOUNT aa ON a.AUTHORITY_ID = aa.AUTHORITY_ID WHERE aa.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND a.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.AUTHORITY_ID, A.AUTHORITY_NAME, A.CREATE_DT, A.UPDATE_DT, A.CREATE_ID, A.UPDATE_ID, A.DEL_YN, A.IS_SYSTEM FROM T3000_AUTHORITY A
JOIN T3000_AUTHORITY_DEPT AD ON A.AUTHORITY_ID = AD.AUTHORITY_ID
WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND AD.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND AD.DEL_YN = 'N'
ORDER BY
${sortField} ${sortOrder}
A.AUTHORITY_ID DESC
SELECT AUTHORITY_ID, AUTHORITY_NAME, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT, CREATE_ID, UPDATE_ID, DEL_YN, IS_SYSTEM FROM T3000_AUTHORITY WHERE AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T3000_AUTHORITY ( AUTHORITY_NAME, CREATE_DT, CREATE_ID, DEL_YN, IS_SYSTEM ) VALUES ( #{authorityName}, SYSDATE, #{createId}, 'N', #{isSystem} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T3000_AUTHORITY SET AUTHORITY_NAME = #{authorityName}, UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, IS_SYSTEM = #{isSystem} WHERE AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE T3000_AUTHORITY SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE WHERE AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId}
